metric: Per-inference compute overhead vs. running the same model in plaintext (multiplier, log scale)

approaches.label: Plain inference
approaches.note: The thing every other bar is paying to improve on.

approaches.label: TEE-attested
approaches.trust: silicon vendor + whoever racks the server
approaches.privacy: encrypted memory; broken by physical access (TEE.fail, Oct 2025)
approaches.note: Under 7% throughput overhead for H100 confidential computing on Llama-class models; overhead shrinks as models grow.

approaches.label: Optimistic re-execution
approaches.trust: at least one honest, solvent watcher
approaches.privacy: none — inputs must be public to replay
approaches.note: Pay for 2–4 replicated executions plus a dispute game nobody runs on the happy path.

approaches.label: zkML proof
approaches.privacy: possible (weights or inputs), at extra proving cost
approaches.note: 10³–10⁵× proving overhead caps practical zkML at tens of millions of parameters.

approaches.label: FHE inference
approaches.finality: seconds–minutes per token (GPT-2: ~11 s/token on GPU)
approaches.trust: threshold key committee (13-party MPC for on-chain FHE)
approaches.privacy: cryptographic — server computes on data it cannot read
approaches.note: GPT-2 at ~11 s/token (GPU) / ~300 s/token (CPU) in Concrete ML's hybrid scheme; literature puts full FHE inference up to 5 orders of magnitude over plaintext.

approaches.label: Verifiable FHE (research)
approaches.privacy: cryptographic, with a proof the ciphertext is honest
approaches.note: ZHE (2025) proves HE evaluations at 27–36× the cost of the evaluation itself — stacked on FHE's 10³–10⁵×, the only trustless private inference costs 10⁴·⁴–10⁶·⁶×.
